# Dependency Rules

1. Authority may define contracts for every plane; imported authority cannot replace Lab authority.
2. Product meaning may depend on admitted authority, never on implementation details.
3. Context packages expose explicit maps and bindings; directory proximity creates no relationship.
4. Implementation depends on product/context contracts; bindings do not redefine them.
5. Evidence observes all planes but grants no approval or activation.
6. Platform installs runtimes from profiles/locks; imported caches and build trees are excluded.
7. Tooling generates projections and validates contracts; generated views never become canonical axes.
8. An unmapped source path or divergent target collision blocks the migration.

Mapping rules: `42`.
